scope: This v3 experiment completed its specified local and five-target development 20um last200 hold gates.
The 20um gate is not the original 0.35um settled-frame success criterion.
E41 was already used for development selection, including the authorized repair trigger; it is not an independent final test.
Five targets do not establish screen10/dev20 or independent final-test performance.
Small near-case endpoints are simulation results under specified starts, not general hardware precision.
Data and training/retention changes are combined; no single-factor causal attribution.
Publication starts no experiments and preserves failed candidate and preflight evidence.
